whatIs: ColorSpace generates color palettes from a color you type in, and also builds gradients, including a three-color gradient mode.
It's a good fit when you already have a brand color and want ideas for combinations or a gradient without designing the palette by hand.
uses: Getting a supporting palette from a project's main color.
Creating a background gradient for a hero or a card.
Trying a three-color gradient before turning it into CSS.
caveats: It's a generation tool: there are no accounts or saved projects to keep your palettes, so write down the codes you choose.
Check the contrast of the resulting colors before using them for text.
pricingNote: Free to use in the browser.
idealFor: Starting from a single color to get palettes and gradients.
